verdict.rationale: The product ships as both a Claude Code marketplace plugin (`claude plugins install mattpocock-skills`) and as files copied/committed directly into a project repo, with an update mechanism (`npx skills update`) for teams to stay in sync — directly matching the marketplace/shared-repo/committed-files distribution story. missing for 10: no independent case study of a team actually rolling this out together (only single-maintainer docs and mixed HN community reaction), and no evidence of a private/self-hosted shared-repo workflow for orgs beyond the public marketplace/npx flow.
